Chapter 219: Chapter 15: Breaking Through to the Sixth Rank (Please Subscribe)

Just a few breaths had passed.

Surrounding the tournament stage, countless spectators gradually recovered, erupting in thunderous cheers.

These cheers were like a tsunami, especially from the viewers of the Chikun Star Domain, almost causing a riot.

“What just happened?”

“The Wanyang Holy Son was slapped into submission by the Peak Master of Shisan?”

“That’s the Wanyang Holy Son, right? What’s going on, did he deliberately concede?”

...

“Concede your whole family, didn’t you see how the Peak Master of Shisan’s two slaps completely shattered the Wanyang Holy Son’s body? Although I have no idea how the Wanyang Holy Son managed to survive, it’s clearly evident that he’s no match for the Peak Master of Shisan.”

“What in the world happened? Wasn’t the Peak Master of Shisan unable to beat the Wanyang Holy Son before? How is it now? In just a few days, their strengths have reversed?”

“Too terrifying… The Peak Master of Shisan is too fearsome, shattering the Wanyang Holy Son’s physical body with two slaps. With such combat power, I estimate he’s reached the threshold of the Sixth Rank.”

“What were those people from the Wanyang Star Domain barking about earlier? Saying something about a defeated opponent? Keep talking now…”

Countless voices of discussion exploded.

If it was just the Wanyang Holy Son being defeated, it wouldn’t have caused such a huge reaction; after all, among human civilization, there’s no shortage of geniuses, and although the Wanyang Holy Son could certainly be considered first-rate, he was definitely not invincible.

But the one who defeated the Wanyang Holy Son was none other than the very Peak Master of Shisan who had recently lost to the Holy Son.

Such a stark contrast, along with the ease in which the Peak Master of Shisan defeated the Wanyang Holy Son, ignited the emotions of numerous spectators.

…

“Wow, the Peak Master of Shisan is so powerful.”

Lin Yi stood up excitedly as well.

“That’s terrifying, that’s the Wanyang Holy Son, and he was just crushed.” A few of Lin Yi’s friends at her side burst out in astonishment.

“Of course.”

Lin Yi then suddenly remembered her own brother.

“If only my brother could learn from the Peak Master of Shisan, that would be great.”

Lin Yi sighed, not because she looked down on Lin Yuan, but because all this time, Lin Yuan never accompanied her to watch the Peak Master of Shisan’s matches.

Such disinterest in the strong, Lin Yi didn’t know what to make of it.

…

“Our little junior brother…”

In a VIP box, the twelve Peak Masters of the Red Kun Lineage looked at each other.

Initially, they were puzzled why their junior brother would still challenge the Wanyang Holy Son, but now, everyone understood.

“Too abnormal…”

Every Peak Master had the same thought in their minds.

They were aware of their junior brother’s partial true identity, not yet a hundred years old.

But now, the power that the little junior brother had demonstrated certainly indicated he’d reached perfect soul fusion.

That is to say,

The little junior brother could step into the Sixth Rank at any time.

Such a speed of cultivation was somewhat embarrassing for the nine elder brothers who were still at the Sixth Rank.

“Originally I thought we had a few decades, but I didn’t expect we could go back so soon…” Among all Peak Masters, the eldest brother’s expression was the most bizarre.

He, in order to curry favor with the little junior brother, had specially dispatched an avatar to reside over Canglan Star, to prevent the Heiyu Ao from making a desperate move.

This avatar, the eldest brother had planned to keep until the little junior brother stepped into the Sixth Rank.

The eldest brother estimated that it would take at least a few decades.

However now, it seems like it would only be a matter of a month.

…

“This is a top talent of my Human Alliance…”

In another stand, Zong Bai, Lü Xiguang, and Cao Rong were full of shock.

The most talented Evolver they had ever seen was Lin Yuan.

At the beginning, during the team competition of the tournament, they were in the same team as Lin Yuan.

In the end, Lin Yuan lived up to expectations, successfully winning the championship of the tournament.

However, Lin Yuan’s performance was completely on a different level compared to the Peak Master of Shisan on the stage.

“One of the future dominators of the Chikun Star Domain.” Heiyu Ao was also watching, and the current performance of the Peak Master of Shisan was so highly regarded that he couldn’t even look up to him; maybe one day when he ascended to the position of clan head of the Heiyu Family, he would have a chance to see this Peak Master of Shisan.

…

“Chikun, you old rascal, you really found a treasure…”

In a crimson palace, a man in a white robe watched the tournament footage, and when he saw Lin Yuan shatter the Wanyang Holy Son with two slaps, he was somewhat stunned.

“He’s reached perfect soul fusion so quickly, and after achieving perfection, his strength has received such an enhancement, what kind of Evolution Path did you practice with him?”

The man in the white robe was experienced and knowledgeable. He was aware that reaching perfect soul fusion alone and having such an explosive increase in strength indicated Lin Yuan’s extremely compatible foundation with his Evolution Path, and that this Evolution Path held immense potential.

“You’ll know in time,” the Chikun Star Lord replied with an unchanged smile, yet deep inside, he too was extremely curious. Lin Yuan’s two slaps just now seemed to not follow the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path; could it be that he cultivated another Evolution Path as well?

“Chikun, tell me honestly, how old is the little disciple you took in? Is he over a hundred years old?”

The man in the white robe understood that the Chikun Star Lord wouldn’t reveal the true identity of the Peak Master of Shisan, so instead of asking about that, he asked about his age.

One could generally gauge the talent of an Evolver by their age.

If the real age of the Peak Master of Shisan was four to five hundred years or even five to six hundred years, then he would just be considered a normal genius.

If he was under a hundred years old,

Then…

It must be said that the Chikun Star Lord had truly found an exceptional genius this time.

“Under a hundred years old,” the Chikun Star Lord replied after a moment’s hesitation.

Far from simply being under a hundred,

If Lin Yuan’s information was correct,

He probably wasn’t even thirty yet?
